documents.text: Inbound call from Mrs Ellison (ID&V passed) 10:42. Very upset, crying at times. Says on Thurs 22/10 she got a call from 'Harbour and Vale fraud team' saying her acc was being used by criminals and she had to move her money to a safe account. Caller knew her name and the last 4 digits of her card. She moved money from her savings to her current acc and then sent two payments on the app while still on the phone with them, £4,800 and then £2,950. Says the man told her what to type. She thinks there was a message on screen but 'he told me to press continue its normal'. Realised when her son David came round on Sat and told her it was a scam. She lives alone since her husband passed last year and says she 'cant sleep, that was money for my funeral'. She wants all her money back. Told her I would raise a complaint and the fraud team would be in touch. Advised her we will never ask her to move money. Gave complaint ref. - P Raman
